He is killed by Meyer Lansky after assaulting Lansky's drug runner Benjamin Siegel. Biography Background He works for New York crime boss Joe Masseria. He has a pair of his men assault their delivery boy Benjamin Siegel as he leaves on a job. They strike in sight of Luciano's headquarters, initially pretending to be looking for a Turkish Baths.
